module: Central manager of the cargos (parcels and materials) of delivery in career mode. It holds the allCargo list (each cargo has an id, a location, an origin, a destination, slots, a weight, modifiers, rewards…), moves cargos between locations (facility, vehicle, player avatar), handles "transient moves" (transientMoves) that are then validated in bulk, provides lookup queries, computes rewards with a breakdown (lateness, loaner, branch level, parking precision), sends lateness messages and cleans up outdated cargos.
notes: A location is a table: {type='facilityParkingspot', facId, psPath}, {type='vehicle', vehId}, {type='playerAvatar'}, {type='multi', destinations={...}} or {type='delete'} (marks for deletion).
sameLocation(a, b) only compares the keys present in a: argument order matters (b may have extra keys) and it crashes if b is nil.
M.addParcelRewards is exported but is always nil (the local variable addParcelRewards does not exist in the file).
clearTransientFlags and undoTransientCargo are leftovers: they only log an error.
The getAllCargo* functions call triggerAllGenerators() of the generator module before filtering: they can therefore generate new offers as a side effect.
The time used (offerExpiresAt, loadedAtTimeStamp) comes from career_modules_delivery_general.time(), not from the real clock.
Lateness multipliers (timed modifier): on time = x1 (+10% money, +50% reputation), partially late = 0.2 to 0.8 linear, late = x0.2 (reputation -1.5x).
In getRewardsWithBreakdown, the logistics precision bonus is computed on originalRewards['logistics'] whereas the skill bonus uses the key logistics-materials or logistics-delivery.
Material merge (cargo.merge): the moved cargo is set to location {type='delete'} and its slots is added to the other; the money reward is then set to cargo.slots.

addParcelRewards.desc: Exported but always nil (reference not defined in the file).

onCareerActivated.desc: Hook called on career activation: stores the other delivery extensions.

addCargo.desc: Adds a cargo to the global list and emits the onCargoGenerated(cargo) hook unless silent.

cargo.desc: Complete cargo (id, location, origin, destination, slots…).

changeCargoLocation.desc: Immediately moves the cargo to newLocation. Adjusts the facility's material stock (removes from the old location, adds to the new one), timestamps loadedAtTimeStamp on the first load into a vehicle, and sets cargo.data.delivered = true if the new location is the destination.

newLocation.desc: New location (an error is logged if nil or empty).

addTransientMoveCargo.desc: Records a pending move for the cargo (cargo._transientMove). Refused with a logged error if it already has one.

hasUncommittedTransientMoves.desc: Indicates whether transient moves have been added but not yet applied.

getTransientMoveCargo.desc: Lists the cargos that have a pending transient move.

clearTransientMoveForCargo.desc: Cancels a cargo's transient move (no effect if none).

clearAllTransientMoves.desc: Cancels all transient moves and resets the "unvalidated" flag to false.

applyTransientMoves.desc: Applies the transient moves whose cargo is at the location currentLocation (or all if currentLocation is nil), updates the loaner organizations of the target vehicles, merges mergeable cargos of the same material at the same location, and keeps the other moves for later.

currentLocation.desc: Current location; nil to apply everything.

getTransientMovesForTargetLocationWithCa.desc: Lists the cargos whose transient move targets the given location.

clearTransientFlags.desc: Obsolete: only logs a "no longer needed" error.

undoTransientCargo.desc: Obsolete: only logs an error (cancellation code commented out, marked TODO).

sameLocationCargo.desc: Compares a cargo's current position with a location via sameLocation.

sameLocation.desc: Tests the equality of two locations by comparing each key of a with the same key of b (asymmetric comparison).

returns.desc: true if all keys of a equal those of b.

getAllCargoCustomFilter.desc: Returns the cargos for which filter(cargo, ...) is true, after triggering all generators.

getAllCargoForLocation.desc: All the cargos currently at this location (triggers the generators if the location is a facility spot).

getAllCargoForLocationUnexpired.desc: Like getAllCargoForLocation but only the cargos whose offer has not expired (offerExpiresAt > delivery time).

getAllCargoForLocationUnexpiredUndeliver.desc: Cargos at this location, not expired, not already at their destination and generated no later than timeGenerated.

getAllCargoForFacilityUnexpiredUndeliver.desc: Same filter but over all the spots of a facility (facId).

getAllCargoForDestinationFacilityStillAt.desc: Non-expired cargos still at their origin and whose destination is the facility facId.

getAllCargoAtFacilityUnexpired.desc: Non-expired cargos still at their origin, located in the facility facId.

getAllCargoInVehicles.desc: Cargos currently in a vehicle, and optionally those with a pending transient move.

getLocationLabelShort.desc: Short label of a location: translated facility name, "Current Vehicle (id)" / "Other Vehicle (id)", "Player Avatar", "N possible locations" (or the label of the single destination), "Unknown". The vehicle/avatar texts are not translated.

getLocationLabelLong.desc: Long label: for a facility spot, "Facility - spot name" if the spot has a custom field name; otherwise same as the short label.

getCargoById.desc: Looks up a cargo by id.

getRewardsWithBreakdown.desc: Computes the rewards of a delivered cargo with a breakdown: effect of the timed modifier (on time, delayed, late), share of the vehicle loaner organizations, multiplier of the logistics branch level, parking precision bonus or penalty. Can unlock the ON_SCHEDULE achievement.

cargo.desc: Cargo (rewards, modifiers, loadedAtTimeStamp, organization, destination, location…).

returns.desc: originalRewards: copy of the base rewards.
breakdown: list of items {label, rewards, simpleBreakdownType}.
adjustedRewards: final rewards (base + sum of the items).

addParcelRewardsSummary.desc: Computes originalRewards/breakdown/adjustedRewards of each cargo, groups by groupId and loading time, formats each group via cargoScreen.formatCargoGroup and sorts by smallest id.

cargo.desc: List of cargos at the same current location.

returns.desc: List of groups formatted for the UI (nil if the list is empty).

cleanUpCargo.desc: Deletes the cargos with location 'delete' and those that stayed at their origin, expired for more than 120 s and without a transient move. Resets the cleanup timer to zero.

onUpdate.desc: Per-frame hook: sends the "delayed" and "late" UI messages for timed cargos in vehicles, updates the tasklist every second, restarts the tasklist and the cleanup if locations changed, and cleans up every 10 s. Inactive outside delivery mode.

onTrailerAttached.desc: Hook called when a trailer is coupled: recomputes the loaner organizations of the cargos located in vehicles.
